$Comment: Resistance to Physical damage the carrier takes, in whole percent points (10 resists a tenth of each hit). Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat (Additive on the Max), and two items carrying it add up. The game reads resistance only from worn armor and active effects, so ziggfreed-common keeps a hidden always-on effect on the player carrying this much DamageResistance on exactly the Physical cause, as vanilla armor keys it, and the game sums it with worn armor's own. A Bludgeoning, Slashing or Crush hit is not reduced by it, just as worn armor's Physical does not reduce one. Projectile hits have their own, DamageResist_Projectile. Held so its sum with worn armor and every other resistance effect stays under DamageResistMax, short of immunity. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps, and a total below 0 resists nothing rather than raising the damage.
